description: Use for "what should I fix on my website?" or "what on my store is costing me sales?". Returns the problems on the store that cost sales from every campaign, each listed once and ranked by impact, with what we saw, the fix, how long it takes and who does it, and what it could be worth in dollars. Found from visits from the brand's Meta ads, no recordings kept. Same view as Store fixes in the Run1Ads app.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

name: get_store_fixes
